Sleep Tight.letra:
# Not a literal translation: re-metered for English phrasing. Hook twists the traditional "good night, sleep tight, don't let the bedbugs bite" rhyme (public domain) — same move as the Spanish lullaby version.

[Intro]
(whispered) Sleep tight… here comes the wolf…

[Verse 1]
She walks in silent, honey in her eyes,
tastes like sweet danger, poison in disguise.
They told me "run" — and I chose to stay:
some loves are fire, and I like the flame.

[Pre-Chorus]
If heaven wants to punish me for wanting her this way,
write my name on the list — I signed it anyway.

[Chorus]
Sleep tight, sleep tight,
here comes the wolf, he owns the night.
Sleep tight, sleep tight:
she is the wolf… and she's coming for me.
Sleep tight, sleep tight,
here comes the wolf, he owns the night.
Sleep tight, sleep tight:
she is the wolf… and I'll wait by the door.

[Verse 2]
She's got a map of sins written down her back,
every kiss a debt that I can't pay back.
If I get lost in her woods, don't come find me:
some cages have open doors and you still can't leave.

[Pre-Chorus]
If heaven wants to punish me for wanting her this way,
write my name on the list — I signed it anyway.

[Chorus]
Sleep tight, sleep tight,
here comes the wolf, he owns the night.
Sleep tight, sleep tight:
she is the wolf… and she's coming for me.
Sleep tight, sleep tight,
here comes the wolf, he owns the night.
Sleep tight, sleep tight:
she is the wolf… and I'll wait by the door.

[Bridge]
If this is a story, it ends in the dark —
but nobody sleeps wanting to wake up.
(whispered) Sleep tight…

[Final Chorus]
Sleep tight, sleep tight,
here comes the wolf, he owns the night.
Sleep tight, sleep tight:
she is the wolf… and she's coming for me.

Wide Awake.letra:
# Receta: dark pop tipo Stellar — Fa menor, 130 BPM, voz pop suave con falsete, Persona «Voz Dark ML».
# Estado: letra aprobada para generar tomas de escucha; SIN subir a DistroKid sin aprobación expresa de Brayan.

[Verse 1]
I sang you off to sleep each night
Now the song is stuck in me
Counting cracks up on the ceiling
Where your shadow used to be

[Pre-Chorus]
The moon is red, the house is cold
I did this — or so I'm told

[Chorus]
Now I'm wide awake
While you're sleeping fine
I gave you all my dreams
And you took your time
Now I'm wide awake
With the mess we made
Sleep tight, love —
I'm the one who pays

[Verse 2]
Your pillow still remembers you
Better than I ever will
I close my eyes, you're standing there
Quiet, darker, still

[Bridge]
Hush now, don't you cry
That's what I sang — what a lie
Hush now, close your eyes
I'm the ghost this time
